reading: The sketch lays out a three-column email client: a slim left sidebar (s0) for a compose button and folder list, a middle column (s1) with a search box and a scrollable list of mail rows, and a wide right pane (s2) showing an opened message, with a smaller box (s3) in its bottom-right drawn as a floating compose window overlaid on top.
